//: The map editor's preset brushes (Presets tab, docs/editor.md). Read when the tab is opened, so a preset added here needs no build. Each preset is layers laid in order; a layer paints the brush's own cells (ring core) or the ring just outside them (ring edge), on every cell or on a share of them (chance). floor: solid, sand, mud, rock, deep; water: true or false; cover: none, forest, trench, minefield; level: -1, 0, 1.

presets.name: pond
presets.say: deep water to the brim, a ford round it

presets.name: hill
presets.say: a level up; the relief slopes its sides

presets.name: wooded hill
presets.say: a level up with a wood on it

presets.name: swamp
presets.say: mud with water standing in a third of it

presets.name: clearing
presets.say: plain ground at the datum, nothing on it
